import random, sys, json, collections
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/t'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/project')
import gen, ref
rng = random.Random(11)
stats=collections.Counter()
for trial in range(400):
    doc=gen.document(rng)
    out=ref.solve(doc)
    for row in out['cases']:
        stats['state:'+row['state']]+=1
        for f in row['flags']: stats['caseflag:'+f]+=1
    for ch in out['channels']:
        stats['err:'+str(ch['error'] and ch['error']['kind'])]+=1
        for r in ch['requests']:
            stats['framing:'+r['framing']]+=1
            for f in r['flags']: stats['reqflag:'+f]+=1
            if len(r['owners'])>1: stats['multiowner']+=1
print(json.dumps(stats, indent=1, sort_keys=True))
PYEOF
